key_highlights: ASX slumps as bond yields spike; unemployment hits 5-year high, signalling stagflationary pressure
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite deteriorating labour market, locking homebuyers out for a decade
AUD 'pulverised' by US economic boom; Trump diesel export ban poses supply-chain risk to Australian energy
Materials sector active: Rio2 Peruvian copper drill, Auric high-grade gold at Munda, Forrestania lifts British Hill past 210k oz
Property market softening: rising listings, falling demand, over half of renters financially stressed
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent tax reform need; energy policy debate intensifies with nuclear call
Jetstar industrial action escalates; data centre energy demand strains grid

sectors.trend: Exploration activity robust across copper and gold; Rio2 Peruvian drill, Auric Munda high-grade gold, Forrestania British Hill 210k oz, Sarytogan 452m copper, Lindian rare earths nearing production. Gold exploration defensive amid rate uncertainty.
sectors.implications: Junior miners (AUR.AX, FRA.AX, MAN.AX, LND.AX) offer optionality; majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) supported by copper demand but pressured by softening Chinese property recovery signals.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite 5-year high unemployment pressures NIMs but raises credit-loss risk. Property market softening (rising listings, falling demand) threatens mortgage book quality. Intergenerational Report flags fiscal stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression vs. rising provisions. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by higher discount rates and weaker occupier demand.

sectors.trend: Fuel costs escalating; Trump diesel export ban threatens Australian supply. Data centre boom strains energy grid. Nuclear energy debate gains traction. Labor energy policy credibility questioned.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDS.AX, SXG.AX benefit from domestic energy scarcity premium. Coal (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) faces policy headwinds. Energy infrastructure (SGH.AX, IAG.AX) supported by data centre demand.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; regional Australia hurt by fuel costs. Renters financially stressed. Ozempic boom reshaping food demand (McDonald's). Property affordability crisis deepens.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption. WES.AX, WOW.AX pressured by consumer squeeze. REITs and property developers (DHG.AX, LVH.AX) face demand deterioration.

sectors.trend: Australia vows AI guardrails after OpenAI breach; global AI chip race intensifies (Nvidia, AMD, Intel). Data centre energy demand a structural tailwind but grid-constrained.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from AI infrastructure spend. Energy-constrained data centres create opportunities for nuclear/uranium (NCV.AX, HAN.AX).

key_themes: Stagflation risk: RBA hiking into rising unemployment
AUD weakness vs USD amid US economic outperformance
Trump trade policy (diesel ban) as external shock to Australian energy
Property market correction: listings up, demand down, renter stress
Commodity exploration momentum in copper and gold
Energy transition tension: data centre demand vs. grid capacity

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike into recession / credit cycle deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight quality financials with strong capital buffers; underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD depreciation and Trump trade policy (diesel export ban)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) that benefit from weaker AUD; monitor energy supply chains

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property market correction and renter stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT exposure; favour defensive consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) over discretionary

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield spike / bond market volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration in fixed income; favour floating-rate notes; monitor 10Y AUS bond yields

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply disruption (fuel costs, data centre demand, nuclear policy)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight integrated energy (WES.AX, SXG.AX); monitor nuclear policy shift for uranium names (NCV.AX)
Monitor QAN.AX earnings guidance; short-term volatility trade

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper exploration names amid rate uncertainty and commodity demand
opportunities.rationale: High-grade discoveries (Auric Munda, Forrestania British Hill 210k oz, Sarytogan 452m copper) provide optionality; gold benefits from rate-cut expectations eventually; copper supported by data centre and EV demand

opportunities.recommendation: Favour integrated energy and uranium on energy scarcity and nuclear policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Fuel cost escalation, Trump diesel ban, data centre energy demand, and nuclear debate create structural tailwinds for domestic energy producers and uranium

opportunities.recommendation: Quality defensive consumer staples in rate-hike environment
opportunities.rationale: Consumer squeeze (renter stress, fuel costs) shifts spending to essentials; WES and WOW offer dividend yield and defensive characteristics

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising listings, falling demand, renter stress, and higher discount rates create downside risk to valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness; favour export-revenue miners
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'pulverised' by US boom; weaker AUD boosts AUD-denominated earnings for BHP, RIO, FMG

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shorten bond duration; monitor 10Y yield spike
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond yield spike risks equity de-rating; floating-rate or short-duration instruments limit mark-to-market risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. RBA hawkish bias into rising unemployment creates stagflation narrative. Bond yield volatility and AUD weakness cap upside. Mining and energy outperform; financials and REITs lag. QAN.AX volatile on Jetstar action. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a range with downside bias until RBA signals pivot.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive for commodity names if global demand holds. Property correction may stabilise by H2 2027. Nuclear policy shift could unlock uranium and energy infrastructure re-rating. Intergenerational Report may catalyse tax reform debate, creating policy uncertainty. AI/data centre capex cycle supports tech and energy infrastructure. Key risk: Trump trade policy escalation.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (hawkish hold vs. pivot)
AUD/USD trajectory and Trump trade policy developments
Iron ore and copper price direction (Chinese property recovery signal)
Property market data: listings, auction clearance, renter stress metrics
Nuclear energy policy decision / legislative progress
watch_list: RBA cash rate and 10Y AUS bond yield
Iron ore (62% Fe) and copper LME prices
CBA.AX, NAB.AX NIM and provision guidance
US 10Y yield and Fed policy divergence
